leads.title: Field Service Technician
leads.adText:
Field Service Technician — Lumen Elevators AB (fictional example ad)
Stockholm region · Full time · Permanent · Service van provided

You will:
- Carry out planned maintenance on lifts and escalators
- Find and fix faults on call-outs, often with customers waiting
- Log every job in our service app

We are looking for:
- Experience in maintenance, automation or technical service
- A structured way of finding faults
- Driving licence (B)
- Swedish and English

We train you on our equipment. Last day to apply: 30 November.

leads.title: NOC Technician
leads.adText:
NOC Technician — Skären Telecom (fictional example ad)
Solna · Full time · 24/7 shift rotation

You will:
- Monitor the network and react to alarms
- Open, follow up and close incidents within SLA
- Escalate to second-line engineers with clear notes
- Write handovers between shifts

We are looking for:
- Experience from support, operations or a NOC
- Networking basics (TCP/IP, DNS)
- Calm under pressure, clear in writing
- Fluent Swedish and English

Selection is continuous.

leads.title: Junior Automation Engineer (trainee)
leads.adText:
Junior Automation Engineer, trainee — Brovik Automation (fictional example ad)
Södertälje · 12-month paid trainee programme

You'll rotate between PLC programming, commissioning at customer sites and our support desk.

We are looking for:
- Ongoing or finished studies in engineering, IT or automation
- Hands-on experience with industrial equipment (a plus)
- Some programming (any language)
- Swedish and English

Apply with CV and a short letter about why automation. Deadline 15 December.
